title: System Redundancy
hook: One frozen payment account can shut your whole business down overnight. It happens more than people admit.
statement: Backups keep one failure from taking everything down. Every critical system needs a plan B.
explainer: Your main client, your main platform, your payment processor. If any one of them disappears tomorrow and there's no backup, revenue just stops.
sop: List every Critical System your business can't run without.
Count how many have a working Backup System.
Build a backup for your riskiest critical system this month.
Actually test that backup once. For real.
Re-audit every 6 months as things change.
equation_example: 2 Backup Systems for 5 Critical Systems. 2 ÷ 5 = 40%. That means 3 things could stop you cold. Higher means more of your essentials are covered. Lower means one failure could shut you down.
question: Write down your biggest single point of failure and one backup you could set up this month.
closing_statement: One working system is one failure away from zero.
caption:
Principle Nº 147: System Redundancy

One frozen payment account can shut your whole business down overnight. It happens more than people admit.

Backups keep one failure from taking everything down. Every critical system needs a plan B.

Your turn: Write down your biggest single point of failure and one backup you could set up this month.
